name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck order and kitchen app
promotionalText: Take orders in advance, prevent orders beyond the kitchen's capacity, and keep selling even when the signal drops. The order-taking app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the order-taking and kitchen-management app for food trucks, the tool your team uses to sell throughout service.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm the orders the kitchen can make, then tap them as ready for collection and collected.

■ Don't promise a time you can't make
Set how many items the kitchen can cook at the same time and how long it takes. When a collection time slot is full, customers can't choose that slot, so the order queue fits the kitchen's capacity.

■ Take orders at the truck
Add orders taken at the truck on the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

■ One screen for the kitchen
The kitchen screen shows what to make now, what to make next and what is ready, with an alert when it is time to start an order.

■ Print order tickets
Connect the kitchen receipt printer via Bluetooth or via the local network, and order tickets print out automatically.

■ Keep selling even when the signal drops
Switch on offline order protection; if the connection drops, ordering ahead pauses, so nobody places an order you can't see. Orders you take on the device are kept and sync when you are back online.

■ Built for use in the truck
Works on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on throughout service, get notified when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

■ Plan your week
Set up your events and locations just once, then take orders for each event.

HatchGrab is for food truck operators and staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
